job.title: Full Stack .Net Developer @ Siemens Healthineers (MH, IN)
job.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

Join our Platform Engineering team to design, develop, and operate shared platform capabilities that enable seamless Cloud (SaaS) and On-Premises solutions.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop and maintain applications using C#/.NET and ASP.NET Core
* Build and support applications running on Kubernetes and Windows/IIS
* Design and implement secure, scalable APIs and distributed systems
* Contribute to Azure-based solutions, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software
* Support Cloud, Hybrid, and On-Premises deployments

**What We're Looking For**

* 3-6 years of experience in C#/.NET software development
* Experience with ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, and distributed systems
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, containers, and cloud-native development
* Knowledge of Azure, CI/CD, DevOps, and Infrastructure as Code
* Understanding of software quality, automated testing, and secure coding practices
* Typescript/Angular experience is a plus

**Preferred Qualifications**

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

Experience working in Agile teams

Strong problem-solving and collaboration skills

**Who we are**: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

**How we work**: When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

To find out more about Healthineers’ specific businesses, please visit our company page here.

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

**Data Privacy**: We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile also lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Register here to get started.

**Beware of Job Scams:** Please beware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as Siemens Healthineers recruiters/employees. These scammers may attempt to collect your confidential personal or financial information. If you are concerned that an offer of employment with Siemens Healthineers might be a scam or that the recruiter is not legitimate, please verify by searching for the posting on the Siemens Healthineers career site.

**To all recruitment agencies**: Siemens Healthineers does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other company location. Siemens Healthineers is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

job.title: Java Developer @ Standard Chartered Bank (KA, IN)
job.description:
Requisition Number: 65561

Job Location: Bangalore, IND

Global Grade: Band 8

Work Type: Office Working

Employment Type: Permanent

Posting Start Date: 06/11/2026

Posting End Date: 20/11/2026

:

**Job Summary**
---------------

App Development is responsible for designing, building, testing and maintaining secure, scalable and high-performing software solutions that support business, client and operational outcomes. The discipline translates business and technical requirements into reliable applications, services, interfaces and digital capabilities that can be safely operated, enhanced and scaled over time.
  
  
Operating across software engineering, API development, database integration, testing, secure coding, DevOps and production support, App Development plays a critical role in delivering technology that is maintainable, resilient and aligned to enterprise standards. The discipline requires strong programming capability, sound engineering judgement, collaboration across technology and business teams, and the ability to balance speed of delivery with quality, security, reliability and long-term sustainability.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Solution Design & Application Development**  
• Design and build software applications, interfaces, APIs and services that meet business requirements while remaining secure, scalable, maintainable and performant.
  
• Translate functional and technical requirements into practical engineering solutions, selecting appropriate patterns, technologies and implementation approaches based on system context and delivery needs.
  
• Develop and maintain application components across relevant technology stacks, which may include web, mobile, backend, integration, database or platform-specific environments.
  
• Apply appropriate programming languages, frameworks and tools — such as Java, JavaScript, Python, Go, Kotlin, React, Angular, Android, HTML/CSS or equivalent technologies — where relevant to the application domain and platform context.
  
**Code Quality, Testing & Engineering Standards**  
• Write and maintain clean, readable, reusable and well-structured code that supports long-term maintainability and reduces avoidable technical debt.
  
• Conduct and participate in code reviews to improve quality, consistency, security and adherence to engineering standards.
  
• Develop and apply automated testing approaches, including unit, integration, API and regression testing, to strengthen delivery confidence and reduce defects.
  
• Improve engineering practices by applying standards for version control, branching, documentation, peer review, test coverage and maintainable design.
  
**Secure Development & Technology Risk**  
• Implement secure coding practices to protect applications, data and customers from security vulnerabilities and technology risks.
  
• Apply security fundamentals across application design and development, including authentication, authorisation, input validation, secrets management and secure API design where relevant.
  
• Identify and remediate common application security issues, including web, mobile, API and data-related vulnerabilities.
  
• Ensure development activities align with internal technology controls, software delivery standards and applicable governance requirements.

**API, Integration & Data Engineering**  
**• Design and develop APIs, integration points and service interfaces that enable reliable data exchange between systems, platforms and digital channels.**  
**• Develop and optimise database structures, queries and data access patterns to support performance, scalability and reliability.**  
**• Apply database development and management practices across relevant database technologies, such as relational databases, MySQL or equivalent platforms, depending on application needs.**  
**• Support distributed system design by considering service boundaries, transaction handling, latency, resilience and dependency management.**  
**DevOps, Deployment & Release Readiness**  
**• Support application deployment through CI/CD practices, automated build pipelines, version control and controlled release processes.**  
**• Collaborate with release, infrastructure and operations teams to ensure applications are deployment-ready and aligned to environment, configuration and operational requirements.**  
**• Use DevOps practices, containerisation or orchestration technologies — such as Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent platforms — where relevant to improve delivery consistency and application portability.**  
**• Prepare applications for production by ensuring appropriate configuration, documentation, operational handover and release readiness activities are completed.**  
**Application Performance, Reliability & Supportability**  
**• Monitor and analyse application performance, errors, logs and operational metrics to identify reliability, scalability or user experience issues.**  
**• Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across application code, APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure dependencies or runtime environments.**  
**• Design and improve applications with supportability in mind, including observability, logging, error handling, recovery behaviour and operational diagnostics.**  
**• Strengthen application resilience by identifying failure points, reducing recurring incidents and improving system behaviour under real-world operating conditions.**

**Technical Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement**  
**• Investigate and resolve complex technical problems using structured analysis, debugging, experimentation and collaboration with relevant specialists.**  
**• Evaluate new tools, frameworks and engineering approaches where they improve maintainability, security, scalability, developer productivity or delivery efficiency.**  
**• Simplify and refactor systems, code and workflows to reduce complexity, improve performance and address technical debt.**  
**• Apply lessons learned from defects, incidents, reviews and delivery challenges to improve future engineering outcomes.**  
**Stakeholder Collaboration & Delivery Alignment**  
**• Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, designers, testers, release teams, infrastructure teams and other engineers to align solutions with user and business needs.**  
**• Communicate technical options, risks, dependencies and trade-offs clearly to support effective decision-making.**  
**• Contribute to agile delivery practices by participating in planning, refinement, estimation, reviews and continuous improvement activities.**  
**• Document technical designs, implementation decisions, interfaces and support information to enable maintainability, knowledge sharing and operational continuity.**

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Priority Skills**  
**• Software Engineering**  
**• Programming Principles**  
**• Application Programming Interface**  
**• Database Development**  
**• Distributed Systems**  
**• DevOps**  
**• Software Testing**  
**• Secure Coding**  
**• Web Application Security**  
**• Mobile Security**

**Other Skills**  
**• Platform Management**  
**• Operating Systems**  
**• Computer Network**  
**• Database Administration**  
**• Functional Writing**

**Motivations**
---------------

* **Motivated by solving complex problems through technology and engineering creativity.**

**• Energised by learning, experimenting and continuously improving technical solutions.**  
**• Thrives in collaborative environments where innovation, quality and craftsmanship are valued.**

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **Experience contributing to the development of software solutions that support business, customer or operational outcomes.**

**• Experience working in collaborative, cross-functional delivery teams where requirements are translated into technology solutions.**  
**• Experience applying structured problem-solving approaches to resolve technical challenges and improve system performance.**  
**• Experience working within engineering environments that emphasise quality, maintainability, security and continuous improvement.**  
**• Experience adapting to evolving technologies, development practices or delivery approaches while maintaining effective outcomes.**  
**• Business English**

**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

**We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.**

**Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.**

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation** **, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.**
* **In line with our Fair Pay Charter** **, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.**
* **Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance** **, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.**
* **Time-off** **including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.**
* **Flexible working** **options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.**
* **Proactive wellbeing support** **through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.**
* **A continuous learning culture** **to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.**

**Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.**
